experiment: Corpus-derived calibration of remaining Auto-EQ confidence cutoffs

configuration.threshold_selection: Training F1 maximum; retain candidate only when validation F1 improves by >=0.03, precision regret <=0.02, and both validation classes have at least three observations.

clean_preservation.definition: paired clean/noisy correction response agrees within predefined component gates

listening_status.reason: This hardening goal excludes human involvement; thresholds change only when held-out objective classification improves.

limitations: Paired SNR renders test condition stability, not repeated-take agreement.
The corpus is simulated 16 kHz multilingual speech, not native product-like 48 kHz close-mic capture.
Between-take agreement remains unavailable and is not inferred from these pairs.
